create-blog-post.label: Create Blog Post
create-blog-post.description: Creates a draft or published post on a HubSpot blog.
create-blog-post.afterResponse:
if (inputs.status === 'PUBLISHED') call({method: 'POST', url: '/content/api/v2/blog-posts/' + response.id + '/publish-action', body: {action: 'schedule-publish'}});
return call({method: 'GET', url: '/content/api/v2/blog-posts/' + response.id});

templatePath.description: The theme template to use, without a leading slash.

language.description: A language code such as en-us or de-de.

create-page.afterResponse:
if (inputs.state === 'PUBLISHED_OR_SCHEDULED') call({method: 'POST', url: '/content/api/v2/pages/' + response.id + '/publish-action', body: {action: 'schedule-publish'}});
return call({method: 'GET', url: '/cms/v3/pages/' + (inputs.pageType === 'site_page' ? 'site-pages' : 'landing-pages') + '/' + response.id});
